shared_elements: predatory/feline-like animal with head turned or facing viewer
low-relief carving with raised outline and plain infill
justification: Both surfaces show the same repertoire of animals — profile quadrupeds/predators with heavy limbs and heads, plus a large beaked bird and serpentine forms — rendered as flat low relief with a raised smooth outline against an unmodelled ground, and stacked into horizontal registers on a monolithic block face. The main difference in content is that B includes a distinct top register of repeated arch/loop signs above a fringed band and a dense vertical column of separate creatures, whereas A shows a single crowded field of interlocking quadrupeds without the emblem row.
